critical_code_review_comments: ShareRail.onCopy in /app/frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.jsx only calls setCopied(true) inside the try block. If navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects (insecure context, permission denied, or older browsers), the UI gives no feedback. Recommend wrapping setCopied(true) outside the try, or using a document.execCommand('copy') fallback, so the icon swap is guaranteed regardless of clipboard success — minor UX/robustness improvement.

/api/blog/posts uses Mongo sort('published_at', -1) with strings. The seeded ISO datetimes are timezone-aware ISO8601 so lexical sort matches chronological sort here, but if a future post is seeded with a non-UTC offset or a non-ISO format the sort can silently misorder. Consider storing published_at as a BSON datetime (or always-Z normalised) and adding a sort index.

BlogPostPage navigates to /blog on any error whose message contains '404'. api.getBlogPost should ideally throw an Error subclass with a status code field; matching on the string '404' is brittle if the helper changes its error message format.

SeoMeta correctly accepts an array of jsonLd objects and renders them all as separate <script type='application/ld+json'> tags via Helmet — good. siteOrigin() falls back to https://smartpaw.ge for SSR, which is fine for the marketing site.

seed_blog.py only inserts when collection is empty. If a Markdown post is edited or a new file added later, the new content will NOT be re-seeded unless the collection is dropped. A 'force refresh on file mtime change' or admin-only reseed endpoint would help long-term.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_BlogPhase6 lead and TEST_Phase6 contact-inquiry via public APIs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 is fully validated end-to-end (backend blog endpoints + frontend list/post pages + SeoMeta on all marketing pages + FAQPage JSON-LD with 23 entries + Article/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on blog posts). Phase 4/5 regressions still hold. Only soft code-review suggestions remain (see critical_code_review_comments) — none are functional bugs. If the next phase touches Helmet meta, remember Helmet applies asynchronously; tests should sleep ~500–700ms after navigation before reading document.title or head tags. The earlier 'copy icon swap: False' headless observation is a clipboard permission artifact, not a product bug — once page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) is granted the icon swaps correctly.
rca of the issue: No production issues identified this iteration. Note for testers: navigator.clipboard.writeText throws NotAllowedError in headless Playwright unless clipboard-write permission is explicitly granted on the browser context; that is what produced the initial 'Copy icon swap: False' line in the first run. Mitigation in tests: page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=base_url). Mitigation in product (optional, see code review): move setCopied(true) outside the try block in ShareRail.onCopy so the visual feedback fires even if clipboard write rejects.
